description: Java class implementing a FreeMarker template transform for generating alternative URLs for content in the OFBiz framework. It retrieves content URLs based on content ID and view parameters, utilizing OFBiz entity queries and URL encoding.

classes.name: OfbizContentAltUrlTransforms
classes.description: Implements FreeMarker's TemplateTransformModel to generate alternative content URLs based on content ID and view parameters.

methods.name: getStringArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from a map of arguments, handling different object types.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Provides a Writer that processes the template output, generating URLs based on request and response objects.

methods.name: makeContentAltUrl
methods.description: Constructs an alternative URL for content based on entity data; falls back to default URL if none found.

methods.name: makeContentUrl
methods.description: Builds a standard content URL with context path, view, and content ID parameters.
